about: Every message Aaron typed or dictated in this session on Terra (the PC), copied verbatim from its log on 25 September 2026. Only his words. Taken from both places the log keeps them - the queued record of every message he sends and the plain user records - each message kept once at its earliest time. Messages he sent while Claude was still working sit in time order with the rest and are not marked apart, because a queued record alone does not show that. System text, tool output, skill instructions, task notifications, cross-session messages, compaction summaries and anything the studio wrote are excluded, as are the helper agents' logs beside this one. WARNING: this session's working folder was this project's, but its subject is a Premiere/Final Cut XML-to-CSV logging tool (now the editing-apps project), not the game. It is saved here because these are his words and this is the only log folder that holds them.
title: Premiere XML to CSV archive log

messages.text: I need to code a program that will allow me to upload a Final Cut XML exported from Premiere and export out a CSV so that I can create an archive log. I need it to keep it organized by timecode in 00:00:00:00 (hours:minutes:seconds:frames) based on the FPS in the XML. In between uploading and exporting I need to be able to select which columns I want to keep because there are a lot of things in the XML file but I don't need every piece of information.
Ok this is a great start but when I click export CSV nothing happens
